evm.description: Full Solidity 0.8.x compatibility with 2-second blocks and 1,000-5,000 TPS. Deploy your existing smart contracts seamlessly.

zkrollup.description: Layer 2 scaling to 500,000+ TPS with STARK, SNARK, Plonk, and Groth16 proof support. Decentralized sequencer network.

ai.title: Native AI Marketplace
ai.description: Decentralized AI compute marketplace with on-chain job settlement. Run inference, training, and fine-tuning jobs on a global GPU network.

wasm.title: Rust/WASM Contracts
wasm.description: Write high-performance smart contracts in Rust. Cross-VM interoperability allows EVM and WASM contracts to call each other.
